prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1285
Claimant:
Matthew Gregory
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
2023-12-07
First notice of loss was received for a low-speed head-on collision in which the insured's vehicle struck another car at
the front end. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact is being routed through the attorney's
office.
2024-01-19
Reviewed the policy and confirmed the driver involved is listed as a named insured driver with coverage in force at
the time of the loss. No issues with the policy were found.
2024-02-23
Police report and statements from the claimant confirm the claimant was seated in the vehicle when the collision
occurred. The claimant has given the same account of events in every conversation so far.
2024-02-26
Inspection of the vehicle shows damage that is mostly consistent with the described impact. No prior damage to the
vehicle is known, and nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the start of coverage.
2024-02-29
No independent evidence of the accident has come in yet. There are no witnesses, no photographs from the scene,
and no ohter reports beyond the police record of the vehicles involved.
2024-03-19
Medical records show a knee injury that fits the type and force of the collision. Treatment followed a typical course
and tapered off as the claimant improved.
2024-04-04
Records also show the claimant was treated for the same body area within the last two years. That earlier condition
appears to add to the current complaints and will be factored into the evaluation.
2024-04-19
Counsel has been asked for the full treatment history and any prior records related to the knee. Requested
documents are pending and the file remains open for review.
2024-05-31
Preliminary assessment completed: the injury is consistent with the collision, but the prior knee condition and the lack
of independent corroboration of the accident itself will need to be weighed before any settlement position is set.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
